question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When Sarah realised that she forgot her keys at home, she felt like a fish out of _________.
solution:
Here’s the HTML solution for your question:

```html
The correct answer is '**water**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**a fish out of water**" means feeling uncomfortable or out of place in a particular situation.
 
• In this context, Sarah felt uneasy because she forgot her keys at home.
